positions.notes: Source: 29df30f ar «مطبخٌ دافئ: الأرز الأحسائي والهريس والمفلق وخبز التمر.» / en «A warm kitchen: Hasawi rice, harees, mufallaq and date bread.» (Arabic authority; ar and en agree on all four dishes and their order). Dish names taken byte-for-byte from DISH_GROUPS_RU name fields in src/data/dishes.ts («Рис Аль-Ахсы», «Хариса», «Муфаллак», «Финиковый хлеб»), lowercased at the head of each item because they run inside a sentence — the same form the published food SEO description uses (TM page food / ui.description: «рис Аль-Ахсы, … хариса из пшеницы, муфаллак, … и финиковый хлеб»). «Душевная кухня» = the approved TM rendering of «A warm kitchen» (TM ui.cat.taste.d 2026-09-05), reused; a calque «Тёплая кухня» reads as a heated room. Termbase: рис Аль-Ахсы (no colour — «красный» only where the source says red; here it does not), хариса ж, муфаллак м, финиковый хлеб м — all in nominative, rod/sklonenie satisfied. «из пшеницы»: required by termbase ru-food F1/F2 — the card description is a separate surface (index card) and a bare enumeration with no generic noun, exactly the surface where «хариса» was read by the blind reader as the pepper sauce «харисса»; F2 licenses only a short determiner taken from the cuisine page itself (dish card: «Пшеница и мясо…»), and this is the identical wording already published in the food SEO description (E5). Not a new fact; no warning about «харисса» (REJ-2). Name itself unchanged. Colon kept as in source; no serial comma; no U+00A0; 75 chars (peers cat.*.d 68–93). C5b unaffected (alias is «красный хлеб» → canonical «финиковый хлеб»; this adds only the canonical). Checklist 1–11: PASS (no Вы/ты, no anglicisms, no gloss needed on a card, no heading).
